scene.value: An empty shallow tidal beach in clear midday sun. She squats steadily on damp sand beside a small tide pool, pointing loosely toward a shell on the sand with one hand while the other rests open on her thigh. Both feet, face and both distinct hands visible, sea foam and turquoise water around her.

outfit.value: Fully lined ochre-yellow two-piece swimwear: secure scoop-neck top with broad crossed back straps, matching high-waisted bottoms with opaque full coverage and green seam piping, small leaf-shaped bracelet. Bare shoulders, waist and legs, no armor.

custom.value: One clearly adult woman in her 20s. Both hands fully within the chosen framing, each hand exactly one thumb and four individually separated fingers with coherent knuckles; no fused digits or extra fingers. No weapons, text, logo, border or duplicate figure.
